evals.prompt: Analyse media photos/winter-paddock-green.jpg — Dexter cattle in lush green pasture, mid-north coast NSW winter morning.
evals.expected_output: Structured JSON: subjects, season, moods, contentType, altText, description, qualityScore, publishable, publishNotes.
assertions: Output is JSON with subjects, season, altText, description, qualityScore, and publishable fields
Subjects are specific (e.g. Dexter cattle) not generic (e.g. wildlife)
Season reflects NSW climate — lush green pasture consistent with winter/post-summer recovery not Northern Hemisphere spring
Description uses honest establishing-phase register per brand-voice
altText names primary subject, setting, and mood — not generic 'a photo of a farm'
qualityScore is a float between 0.0 and 1.0 consistent with visible technical quality
